notes: On a tablet, a pencil draws and the pen's line is wider where you press harder. Once you have used a pencil, one finger moves the page, two fingers pinch to zoom, and a hand resting on the screen does nothing.
Settings, Marking has a new Tablet and pencil section: choose what a finger does on the paper, or turn off the wider line.
On a touch screen the tools, the student rows and the score buttons are larger.
